f3_program: observe(at("issuer.common_stock.shares_purchased.count", "February 23, 2019 - March 22, 2019"), 3380, "thousand_shares", cell("February 23, 2019 - March 22, 2019", "Total Number of Shares Purchased"))
observe(at("issuer.common_stock.shares_purchased.count", "March 23, 2019 - April 26, 2019"), 3608, "thousand_shares", cell("March 23, 2019 - April 26, 2019", "Total Number of Shares Purchased"))
assumptions: The second and third month periods refer to the second and third dated period rows, excluding the Total row.
The cited year cells are the subcolumns beneath the Revenues header.
The directional phrase “from 2019 to 2018” is represented in that stated order.
“In 2019 from 2018” denotes a change from the 2018 value to the 2019 value.
The cited Granted rows are those within the RSUs section of the table.
The amounts represent fair value in millions of dollars, as stated by the paragraph and table unit label.

The 2019 total accrued-liabilities value is in a table row whose row-label cell is empty, so it cannot be grounded with the required non-empty cell(row,column) labels. Reconstructing the total from components would add a solution aggregation not explicitly representable as a grounded numeric observation.
